queue.title: Compiler ICE importing packages with local types inside generic functions
queue.detail: logos.reachableFuncFactObjects and the overlay-clone scope walks iterated pkg.Scope().Names() skipping only dotted names. Lazily-imported scopes also carry hoisted local types with vargen names (T·N); forcing their lookup reaches object dicts with implicit type parameters that the simplified importer cannot materialize: base.Fatalf "unexpected object with N implicit type parameter(s)". Any Go package with a local type inside a generic func (e.g. creachadair/mds slice.LCSFunc seq) made dependents uncompilable: go build, go vet, logos lint, gglint all ICE'd.
queue.fix: Added importedDeclNames() filtering vargen-suffixed (T·N) and dotted (T.M) names via types.SplitVargenSuffix, applied to all four imported-scope iterations in optfacts.go — matching gcimporter's promoted-name filters.

queue.title: Round-3 deep dogfood: lsp/context/eject verified; lint phase-gating documented
queue.detail: logos lsp (gopls proxy) verified end-to-end on .lgo: didSave publishes 'undefined: undefinedFunction' mapped to the .lgo URI. logos context resolves std/dep/.lgo/generic symbols correctly. logos eject lowers ?, errdefer, go group, and yield generators to stock Go that vets clean and runs correctly. Key lint semantics verified: deny-severity diagnostics are compiler-stage errors flushed before ExitIfErrors, which gates the type-dependent registry checks (unbounded_channel_op, defer_erases_errdefer_state) — a file/package with any compiler-stage deny gets only those findings until fixed and re-linted (phased reporting, matches irgen ExitIfErrors design). logos lint silently skips the toolchain's own cmd module because cmd/... packages classify Standard with nil Module (same boundary as std). gglint self-dogfood on src/cmd (2244 findings, 33 analyzers, zero crashes). New corpus coverage: adversarial-lgo/{denied,checks} split attacks by phase so all rule families get exercised.

queue.title: logos lint never lints _test.go files (coverage gap vs go vet)
queue.detail: work/lintActor compiles only p.GoFiles (work/logos_lint.go:78); TestGoFiles/XTestGoFiles are never linted. A package of only _test.go gets rc=0 silently, and violations inside _test.go of a normal package never surface — gglint flags them (goroutine leak in test caught on the same probe). go vet covers test files. The SPEC _test.go exemption in pedantic::unsafe_outside_unsafe_file (Sec 1.2) implies test files were meant to be linted. Candidate design gap: either extend LintAction to test variants or document the exclusion.
queue.fix: runLint now builds test variants via load.TestPackagesFor (like go vet): ptest linted in place of p (GoFiles+TestGoFiles), pxtest linted for external test packages. Broken test variant reports the error and still lints non-test files.

queue.title: -json-diagnostics mixes raw-text errors with JSON diagnostics on stderr
queue.detail: Scanner/loader-level errors (illegal UTF-8 encoding, build constraints exclude all files, import cycle, ambiguous import) print as raw 'file:line: message' text on the same stderr stream as -json-diagnostics output. queue.title: linkname-mismatch rule skipped linkname targets in transitively-reached packages
queue.detail: Packages reached only through another package's export data are shells carrying just the objects the intermediate package references; linkedSymbol returned nil for linkname targets living in them, so rule_linkname_mismatch silently skipped (TestLinknameMismatchTransitiveImport red at HEAD).
queue.fix: Added optional Input.Importer; on a nil target the rule re-imports the package in full and retries the lookup.

queue.title: Importer.Import retry on an unresolved transitive package aborts on pkg1.Direct invariant
queue.detail: readImportFileImpl set pkg1.Direct = true and appended to target.Imports before the import could fail. types.NewPkg caches *types.Pkg per path, so a failed import left Direct set while packages[path] stayed incomplete; a later import of the same path hit the 'unexpected Direct package' invariant (base.Fatalf).
queue.fix: On every post-Direct error return, roll back pkg1.Direct and remove pkg1's own target.Imports entry (not the tail: recursive imports may have appended completed dependencies after it) when packages[path] never completed; keep both when it did.
